result.summary: The layout is broadly coherent, but the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel has hard-clipped text, the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards, and the first restaurant thumbnail doesn't match the visual treatment of its siblings. Found 5 issues.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title ('Trattoria Piccol…') and image are hard-cut by the viewport edge with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Truncate card titles with an ellipsis at the card width, and add a peek/fade gradient at the right edge so the carousel clearly reads as horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a dark outline heart on a white circle, while the pizza card below uses a white heart on a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardize one favorite-button treatment (e.g. white circle + dark outline heart) across all restaurant cards, with a single filled/active state.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while all other food thumbnails use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually unbalanced and the time badge lower-contrast.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image background/overlay treatment (or a uniform dark scrim) to all carousel thumbnails so badges keep consistent contrast.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut mid-chip at the right edge (a partial chip is visible beyond 'Healthy') with no affordance indicating more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/edge fade so the next chip is partially but intentionally visible, signalling scrollability.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no bottom spacing, so its title/metadata are hidden and the card appears truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so cards scroll fully clear of the tab bar.
